case.question: 我的词表是 apple=苹果、river=河流。安排三项词汇练习，每项两步，每步给动作、理由和时长，全部最多6分钟。
case.expected: Three genuine practice activities with two children each, total <=360 seconds, existing two pairs, materials/hidden answers and zero errors coherent.

answer:
1. 看词说义 (120 秒): 在纸上写两列：左列 WORD 写 apple、river，右列 MEANING 写苹果、河流；用纸盖住 MEANING 列，逐个看 WORD 说出中文意思，每说完一个就掀开核对，再重新盖住 MEANING 列，然后进行下一个。 先建立两列词表并立即做一次遮盖核对，把准备和首次练习合在一起，同时确认哪些词还不熟。 重新盖住 MEANING 列，按顺序再看 apple、river 说意思，每说一个掀开核对后立刻盖回，全部过完后把说错的词在 WORD 列旁做小标记。 第二遍遮盖练习强化词到义的回忆，标记帮助后续优先练不熟的词。 本计划任一步骤若没有可用错词或数量不足，就用原词表中的可用词继续；词数不够可重复，均在该步骤原定时长内完成。
2. 看义写词 (120 秒): 盖住 WORD 列，只看 MEANING 列的苹果、河流，在另一张纸上写出对应英文；每写完一个掀开 WORD 列核对，再盖回 WORD 列，然后写下一个。 从中文意思回忆英文拼写，检验反向提取，核对后立即恢复遮盖保持测试条件。 重新盖住 WORD 列，优先按做小标记的顺序看苹果、河流写英文，每写完一个掀开核对并盖回；若没有标记就按原顺序练，全部写对即可结束。 优先练不熟的词，同时保证零错误时也有明确的完成条件。
3. 双向快测 (120 秒): 盖住 MEANING 列，快速看 apple、river 说中文，每说一个掀开核对后盖回；然后盖住 WORD 列，看苹果、河流写英文，每写完一个掀开核对后盖回。 在同一时段内交替练词到义和义到词，巩固两个方向。 针对最后核对中仍出错的词，单独盖住对应列再练一遍：看词说义或看义写词，每次核对后立即盖回；若全部正确，就把原词表完整遮盖再各过一遍后结束。 用最后核对结果决定收尾重点，零错误时也有明确的替代做法。

case.question: I already have double-sided word cards: meanings on the front and the corresponding English words on the back. Plan two vocabulary revision activities, maximum four minutes in total. Include what to do if I make no errors.
case.expected: Use supplied reverse layout coherently; attempt then check; reset before repetition; explicit usable zero-error branch, <=240 seconds.

answer:
1. Meaning-to-word recall (120 seconds): Shuffle the cards, keep every card meaning-side up, and set aside any card you already know cold so the round uses the full existing set with weak items first; if no cards remain, skip to the second activity. A shuffled meaning-up stack makes recall productive rather than recognition, and prioritising weak cards targets the gaps. For each card, say the English word aloud, then flip it to check the back; if correct, place it in a done pile, and if wrong, say the correct word once and place it in a review pile. Saying the word before flipping tests productive recall and the flip gives immediate feedback. If the review pile is empty, reshuffle the done pile and run one faster pass; otherwise reset every review card meaning-side up and repeat only those cards once. A no-error round still needs a next challenge, while errors get a focused second attempt. In any step, if this subset is empty or too small, use available words from the original list; repeat available words as needed within that step’s allotted time.
2. Word-to-meaning check (120 seconds): Take the checked stack, turn every card word-side up, and shuffle it. Reversing the prompt side tests receptive knowledge and prevents memorising one direction only. For each card, say the meaning aloud, then flip to the front to check; keep correct cards in a done pile and put wrong ones in a review pile. Recalling the meaning before flipping verifies comprehension rather than guessing from the word. If no errors occurred, shuffle the done pile and do a quick mixed pass flipping each card once; if there were errors, reset the review cards word-side up and repeat just those. The no-error branch keeps the session productive, while the error branch consolidates the missed items.

case.question: Make it one paragraph instead, keeping the same total time.

answer: Recall Meanings (2 minutes): first, in a single timed step, write a simple two-column WORD / MEANING list using the words from your own list with their known meanings, then cover the MEANING column, attempt the meaning of each word aloud or on paper, uncover to check each attempt, and immediately cover the MEANING column again before the next word; use the whole list, starting with your weakest items, and if any word is unknown, leave it out rather than inventing a meaning. Recall Words (2 minutes): keep the same WORD / MEANING list, cover the WORD column, attempt each word on paper from its meaning, uncover to check, and cover the WORD column again before each new attempt, again prioritising weak items and using the whole list.
